examples.text: sakko devarājā, kiṃ no sādhāraṇena rajjenā'ti asure dibbapānaṃ pāyetvā matte samāne pādesu gāhāpetvā sinerupabbatapāde khipāpesi. te asurabhavanam'eva sampāpuṇiṃsu.
icc'evaṃ vippalapantiṃ, phandamānaṃ tato tato, khipiṃsu niraye ghore, uddhapādaṃ avaṃsiraṃ.
deva, idāni ṭhapetvā saccakiriyaṃ añño mama sakkhi n'atthi, sac'āyaṃ dārako tumhe paṭicca jāto, ākāse tiṭṭhatu, no ce, bhūmiyaṃ patitvā maratū'ti bodhisattassa pāde gahetvā ākāse khipi.
yasmiṃ samaye samaṇo gotamo anekasatāya parisāya dhammaṃ deseti, n'eva tasmiṃ samaye samaṇassa gotamassa sāvakānaṃ khipitasaddo vā hoti ukkāsitasaddo vā.

23706.meaning2: kinds like sneezing, itch, hay fever, etc.

23707.meaning1: could be thrown; could be deranged; could be disturbed

examples.text: tassa ce amanusso cittaṃ khipitabbaṃ maññeyya, atha kho sv'eva amanusso kilamathassa vighātassa bhāgī assa.
yasmiṃ samaye samaṇo gotamo anekasatāya parisāya dhammaṃ deseti, n'eva tasmiṃ samaye samaṇassa gotamassa sāvakānaṃ khipitasaddo vā hoti ukkāsitasaddo vā.

23709.meaning1: desire to sneeze; fact of wanting to sneeze

examples.text: brāhmaṇassa asiṃ ākaḍḍhitvā upasiṅghantassa maricacuṇṇāni nāsaṃ pavisitvā khipituṃkāmataṃ uppādesuṃ. tassa khipantassa nāsikā asidhārāya paṭihatā dvidhā chijji.
gahapatiko rathā otaritvā kesesu gahetvā nāmetvā kapparapahārehi koṭṭetvā gale gahetvā āgatamaggābhimukhaṃ khipitvā pakkāmi

atha te, jarasakko amhe matte katvā mahāsamuddapiṭṭhe khipitvā amhākaṃ devanagaraṃ gaṇhi, te mayaṃ tena saddhiṃ yujjhitvā amhākaṃ devanagaram'eva gaṇhissāmā'ti kipillikā viya thambhaṃ sineruṃ anusañcaramānā uṭṭhahiṃsu.

idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo khippanisantī ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu, sutānañ'ca dhammānaṃ dhārakajātiko hoti, dhātānañ'ca dhammānaṃ atth'ūpaparikkhī hoti attham'aññāya dhammam'aññāya, dhamm'ānudhammappaṭipanno hoti.
sārattā kāmabhogesu, giddhā kāmesu mucchitā, atisāraṃ na bujjhanti, macchā khippaṃ'va oḍḍitaṃ, pacchā'saṃ kaṭukaṃ hoti, vipāko hi'ssa pāpako'ti.

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, nadīmukhe khippaṃ uḍḍeyya bahūnaṃ macchānaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya anayāya byasanāya, evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, makkhali moghapuriso manussakhippaṃ maññe loke uppanno bahūnaṃ sattānaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya anayāya byasanāyāti.

23718.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of khippatara
23718.meaning2: very soon; very quickly; even faster

examples.text: khippataraṃ kho so, bhikkhave, kāṇo kacchapo vassasatassa vassasatassa accayena sakiṃ sakiṃ ummujjanto amusmiṃ ekacchiggaḷe yuge gīvaṃ paveseyya, na tv'ev'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, sakiṃ vinipātagatena bālena manussattaṃ vadāmi.
tatra, bhante, y'āyaṃ paṭipadā sukhā khipp'ābhiññā, ayaṃ pana, bhante, paṭipadā ubhayen'eva paṇītā akkhāyati sukhattā ca khippattā ca. etadānuttariyaṃ, bhante, paṭipadāsu.

23722.meaning1: learning fast; who is quick to pay attention; who is quick to attend to (to); of quick comprehension

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo khippanisantī ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu, sutānañ'ca dhammānaṃ dhārakajātiko hoti, dhātānañ'ca dhammānaṃ atth'ūpaparikkhī hoti attham'aññāya dhammam'aññāya, dhamm'ānudhammappaṭipanno hoti.

puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, kāmahetu kāmanidānaṃ kām'ādhikaraṇaṃ kāmānam'eva hetu asicammaṃ gahetvā, dhanukalāpaṃ sannayhitvā, ubhatobyūḷhaṃ saṅgāmaṃ pakkhandanti usūsu'pi khippamānesu, sattīsu'pi khippamānāsu, asīsu'pi vijjotalantesu.

23724.meaning1: very quickly; extremely rapidly; very swiftly

examples.text: niṭṭhitacīvarasmiṃ bhikkhunā ubbhatasmiṃ kathine bhikkhuno pan'eva akālacīvaraṃ uppajjeyya, ākaṅkhamānena bhikkhunā paṭiggahetabbaṃ, paṭiggahetvā khippam'eva kāretabbaṃ
taṃ kiṃ maññasi, gahapati, sace so gijjho vā kaṅko vā kulalo vā taṃ maṃsapesiṃ na khippam'eva paṭinissajjeyya, so tatonidānaṃ maraṇaṃ vā nigaccheyya maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhan'ti?

23725.meaning1: fast fading; quick to change; quick to disappear

examples.text: rāgo kho, āvuso, appasāvajjo dandhavirāgī, doso mahāsāvajjo khippavirāgī, moho mahāsāvajjo dandhavirāgī'ti.
katamā ca, bhikkhave, dukkhassa vemattatā? atthi, bhikkhave, dukkhaṃ adhimattaṃ, atthi parittaṃ, atthi dandhavirāgi, atthi khippavirāgi. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, dukkhassa vemattatā.

23726.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of khippa

examples.text: muhuttam'api ce viññū, paṇḍitaṃ payirupāsati, khippaṃ dhammaṃ vijānāti, jivhā sūparasaṃ yathā.
nihīyati puriso nihīnasevī, na ca hāyetha kadāci tulyasevī, seṭṭham'upanamaṃ udeti khippaṃ, tasmā attano uttariṃ bhajethā'ti.
so muṭṭhassati kālaṃ kurumāno aññataraṃ devanikāyaṃ upapajjati. tassa tattha sukhino dhammapadā plavanti. dandho, bhikkhave, sat'uppādo, atha so satto khippaṃ'y'eva visesagāmī hoti.

23728.meaning2: of swift understanding; characterized by quick intuition

23729.meaning1: with fast understanding; with quick realization
23729.commentary: (ANa) khipp'ābhiññānan'ti khippaṃ adhigata-abhiññānaṃ dārucīriyatthero aggo'ti dasseti. ayañ'hi thero saṃkhittadhammadesanāpariyosāne arahattaṃ pāpuṇi, maggaphalānaṃ parikammakiccaṃ n'āhosi. tasmā khipp'ābhiññānaṃ aggo nāma jāto.

examples.text: catasso imā, bhikkhave, paṭipadā. katamā catasso? dukkhā paṭipadā dandh'ābhiññā, dukkhā paṭipadā khipp'ābhiññā, sukhā paṭipadā dandh'ābhiññā, sukhā paṭipadā khipp'ābhiññā. imā kho, bhikkhave, catasso paṭipadā.
etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ khipp'ābhiññānaṃ yadidaṃ bāhiyo dārucīriyo.

23730.meaning1: is destroyed; is exhausted; is worn away; is drained

examples.text: yathā ca bhikkhave tassa purisassa javo, yathā ca candimasuriyānaṃ javo, yathā ca yā devatā candimasuriyānaṃ purato dhāvanti, tāsaṃ devatānaṃ javo, tato sīghataraṃ āyusaṅkhārā khiyanti.
ye te bhikkhū app'icchā santuṭṭhā lajjino kukkuccakā sikkhākāmā te ujjhāyanti khiyyanti vipācenti, kathañ'hi nāma āyasmā dhaniyo kumbhakāraputto rañño dārūni adinnaṃ ādiyissatī'ti!
apalokanakammaṃ ñattikammaṃ ñattidutiyakammaṃ ñatticatutthakammaṃ dhammena vinayena satthusāsanena kataṃ, etaṃ dhammikaṃ nāma kammaṃ. chandaṃ datvā khiyyati āpatti pācittiyassa.

23733.meaning1: act of complaining; practice of complaining

examples.text: ujjhāpanake, khiyyanake pācittiyaṃ.
assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khiyyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.

23736.commentary: (SNPa) tasmā munī n'atthi khilo kuhiñcī'ti tena kāraṇena ayaṃ muni rāg'ādikhilehi n'atthi khilo kuhiñcī'ti veditabbo.

examples.text: vadanti ve duṭṭhamanā'pi eke, atho'pi ve saccamanā vadanti, vādañ'ca jātaṃ muni no upeti, tasmā munī n'atthi khilo kuhiñci.
duṭṭho doso'ti kupito anattamano anabhiraddho āhatacitto khilajāto.
cudito vacībhi satim'ābhinande, sabrahmacārīsu khilaṃ pabhinde, vācaṃ pamuñce kusalaṃ n'ātivelaṃ, janavādadhammāya na cetayeyya.
duṭṭho doso'ti kupito anattamano anabhiraddho āhatacitto khilajāto.

23741.meaning1: consumed; spent; finished; exhausted; slowly destroyed

examples.text: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ n'āparaṃ itthattāyā'ti pajānāti
mamāyite passatha phandamāne, macche'va app'odake khīṇasote, etam'pi disvā amamo careyya, bhavesu āsattim'akubbamāno.
n'atthi cetasikaṃ dukkhaṃ, anapekkhassa gāmaṇi, atikkantā bhayā sabbe, khīṇasaṃyojanassa ve.
no ca khv'assa evaṃ ñāṇaṃ hoti, ettakaṃ vata me ajja vāsijaṭassa khīṇaṃ, ettakaṃ hiyyo, ettakaṃ pare'ti. atha khv'assa khīṇe khīṇan'tv'eva ñāṇaṃ hoti.

23744.meaning1: who has removed the passion for sensual pleasure; who has destroyed sensual desire
23744.commentary: (MNa) khīṇakāmarāgo'ti ettha kāmaṃ bhagavato sabbe'pi kilesā khīṇā, brāhmaṇo pana te na jānāti, attano jānanaṭṭhāne'y'eva guṇaṃ katheti.

examples.text: samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo khīṇakāmarāgo vigatacāpallo

23745.meaning1: of a ruined family; belonging to a dead family tree
23745.meaning2: of a ruined family; or of a family whose members are dead

examples.text: khīṇakulīne kapaṇe, anubhūtaṃ te dukhaṃ aparimāṇaṃ, assū ca te pavattaṃ, bahūni ca jātisahassāni.

23746.meaning2: belonging to a family whose members are dead; without kin

23747.meaning2: fact of being wasted or exhausted

examples.text: so ākaṅkhamāno attanā'va attānaṃ byākareyya, khīṇanirayo'mhi khīṇatiracchānayoni khīṇapettivisayo khīṇ'āpāyaduggativinipāto, sot'āpanno'ham'asmi avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano'ti.

ath'assa etadahosi, sace kho pana me puttā imaṃ dhammadesanaṃ sutvā khīṇaniray'amhā khīṇatiracchānayonikā khīṇapettivisayā khīṇ'āpāya-duggati-vinipātā'ti maññamānā uparimaggaphal'atthāya vāyamituṃ na maññeyyuṃ, tesaṃ saṃvegaṃ janessāmī'ti saṃvegajanan'atthaṃ seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave'ti imaṃ suttam'ārabhi.

23750.meaning2: fact of being wasted or exhausted

23751.commentary: (SNa) khīṇanirayo'ti-ādīsu āyatiṃ tattha anuppajjanatāya khīṇo nirayo mayhan'ti so ahaṃ khīṇanirayo. esa nayo sabbattha.

examples.text: so ākaṅkhamāno attanā'va attānaṃ byākareyya khīṇanirayo-amhi khīṇatiracchānayoni khīṇapettivisayo khīṇ'āpāyaduggativinipāto sot'āpanno'ham'asmi avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo'ti

23752.commentary: (ITIa) punabbhavassa khepitattā khīṇapunabbhavā hontī'ti. (THa) anīghā khīṇapunabbhavā isī'ti kilesadukkhābhāvena nidukkhā khīṇapunabbhavā, asekkhānaṃ sīlakkhandh'ādīnaṃ esitabhāvena isī'ti.

examples.text: pajjena katena attanā, parinibbānagato vitiṇṇakaṅkho, vibhavañ'ca bhavañ'ca vippahāya, vusitavā khīṇapunabbhavo sa bhikkhu.
tīhi vijjāhi sampanno, santo khīṇapunabbhavo, evaṃ vāseṭṭha jānāhi, brahmā sakko vijānatan'ti.

23753.meaning1: done with the ghost realm; finished with the world of the forefathers

examples.text: so ākaṅkhamāno attanā'va attānaṃ byākareyya, khīṇanirayo'mhi khīṇatiracchānayoni khīṇapettivisayo khīṇ'āpāyaduggativinipāto, sot'āpanno'ham'asmi avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano'ti.

23754.meaning1: who has destroyed the seed; with no possibility of rebirth
23754.meaning2: who is without the seed of existence

examples.text: khīṇaṃ purāṇaṃ nava n'atthi sambhavaṃ, virattacitt'āyatike bhavasmiṃ, te khīṇabījā avirūḷhichandā, nibbanti dhīrā yath'āyaṃ padīpo, idam'pi saṅghe ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, etena saccena suvatthi hotu.

23755.commentary: (DHPa) khīṇamacche'ti te evarūpā bālā udakassa abhāvā khīṇamacche pallale parikkhīṇapattā jiṇṇakoñcā viya avajhāyanti.

examples.text: acaritvā brahmacariyaṃ, aladdhā yobbane dhanaṃ, jiṇṇakoñcā'va jhāyanti, khīṇamacche'va pallale.

23756.meaning1: who has removed the bonds; who has worn away the fetters; epithet of an arahant
23756.commentary: (UDa) khīṇasaṃyojanā'ti catūhi'pi ariyamaggehi dasavidhassa saṃyojanassa samucchinnattā parikkhīṇasaṃyojanā.

examples.text: n'atthi cetasikaṃ dukkhaṃ, anapekkhassa gāmaṇi, atikkantā bhayā sabbe, khīṇasaṃyojanassa ve.
nāgassa pantasenassa, khīṇasaṃyojanassa muttassa, paṭimantakassa dhonassa, pannadhajassa vītarāgassa, dantassa nippapañcassa, bhagavato tassa sāvako'ham'asmi.
mamāyite passatha phandamāne, macche'va app'odake khīṇasote, etam'pi disvā amamo careyya, bhavesu āsattim'akubbamāno.
tatra, bhikkhave, yaṃ jaññā sammukhā khīṇavādaṃ abhūtaṃ atacchaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ sasakkaṃ taṃ sammukhā khīṇavādaṃ na bhāseyya.

23759.meaning1: with power spent; with force exhausted

23760.meaning2: of rough or hurtful speech; criticizing

23761.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of khīṇa
23761.commentary: (MNa) sammukhā na khīṇan'ti sammukhā'pi khīṇaṃ ākiṇṇaṃ saṃkiliṭṭhaṃ vācaṃ na bhaṇeyya.

examples.text: rahovādaṃ na bhāseyya, sammukhā na khīṇaṃ bhaṇe. ataramāno'va bhāseyya, no taramāno.

23762.meaning1: done with states of misery, bad destinations and lower realms
23762.meaning2: done with states of misery, bad destinations and purgatory

examples.text: so ākaṅkhamāno attanā'va attānaṃ byākareyya, khīṇanirayo'mhi khīṇatiracchānayoni khīṇapettivisayo khīṇ'āpāyaduggativinipāto, sot'āpanno'ham'asmi avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano'ti.

23763.meaning1: who has destroyed the effluents; awakened; epithet of an arahant
23763.meaning2: whose mind is free from mental obsessions

examples.text: te bhikkhave sattā sudullabhā lokasmiṃ ye cetasikena rogena muhuttam'pi ārogyaṃ paṭijānanti aññatra khīṇ'āsavehi
aññena ca kevalinaṃ mah'esiṃ, khīṇ'āsavaṃ kukkuccavūpasantaṃ, annena pānena upaṭṭhahassu, khettaṃ hi taṃ puññapekkhassa hotī'ti.

23764.meaning1: things that are impossible for someone who has destroyed the effluents

23765.meaning1: power of one who has destroyed the effluents; might of an awakened being
23765.commentary: (PMa) satta khīṇ'āsavabalānī'ti khīṇā āsavā assā'ti khīṇ'āsavo, khīṇ'āsavassa balāni khīṇ'āsavabalāni.

examples.text: katame satta dhammā sacchikātabbā? satta khīṇ'āsavabalāni, idh'āvuso, khīṇ'āsavassa bhikkhuno aniccato sabbe saṅkhārā yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya sudiṭṭhā honti.

23769.meaning1: regarding the person who has destroyed the effluents; about the arahant

examples.text: khīṇ'āsavavasena tatiyanayabhūmiparicchedo niṭṭhito.

23772.meaning1: is destroyed; is exhausted; is worn away; is drained

examples.text: accayanti ahorattā, jīvitaṃ uparujjhati, āyu khīyati maccānaṃ, kunnadīnaṃ'va odakaṃ.
yath'āssa passato rūpaṃ, sevato c'āpi vedanaṃ, khīyati n'opacīyati, evaṃ so caratī sato, evaṃ apacinato dukkhaṃ, santike nibbānam'uccati.

23773.meaning1: is depleted; gets less; is worn away (for)

examples.text: accayanti ahorattā, jīvitaṃ uparujjhati, āyu khīyati maccānaṃ, kunnadīnaṃ'va odakan'ti.

23775.commentary: (DNa) khīyitabbaṃ khīyeyyā'ti pakāsetabbaṃ pakāseyya khipitabbaṃ khipeyya, hāretabbaṃ hāreyyāti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: yaṃnūna mayaṃ ekaṃ sattaṃ sammanneyyāma, yo no sammā khīyitabbaṃ khīyeyya, sammā garahitabbaṃ garaheyya, sammā pabbājetabbaṃ pabbājeyya. mayaṃ pan'assa sālīnaṃ bhāgaṃ anuppadassāmā'ti.

23776.meaning1: act of complaining; practice of bemoaning
23776.meaning2: practice of complaining publicly, action of public criticism, denunciation

examples.text: tam'enaṃ asucinā kāyakammena samannāgataṃ, asucinā vacīkammena samannāgataṃ, asucinā manokammena samannāgataṃ pesalā sabrahmacārī disvā khīyadhammaṃ āpajjanti, aho vata no dukkhaṃ ye mayaṃ evarūpehi puggalehi saddhiṃ saṃvasāmā'ti! idam'assa ārodanāya vadāmi.
yo pana bhikkhu dhammikānaṃ kammānaṃ chandaṃ datvā pacchā khīyanadhammaṃ āpajjeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
yo pana bhikkhu samaggena saṅghena cīvaraṃ datvā pacchā khīyanadhammaṃ āpajjeyya, yathāsanthutaṃ bhikkhū saṅghikaṃ lābhaṃ pariṇāmentī'ti, pācittiyaṃ.

23781.meaning1: act of complaining; practice of complaining
23781.commentary: (VIN) pacchā khīyanadhammaṃ āpajjeyyā'ti upasampannassa saṅghena sammatassa sen'āsanapaññāpakassa vā bhatt'uddesakassa vā yāgubhājakassa vā phalabhājakassa vā khajjabhājakassa vā appamattakavissajjakassa vā cīvaraṃ dinne khiyyati, āpatti pācittiyassa.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu dhammikānaṃ kammānaṃ chandaṃ datvā pacchā khīyanadhammaṃ āpajjeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
yo pana bhikkhu samaggena saṅghena cīvaraṃ datvā pacchā khīyanadhammaṃ āpajjeyya, yathāsanthutaṃ bhikkhū saṅghikaṃ lābhaṃ pariṇāmentī'ti, pācittiyaṃ.
yo pana bhikkhu dhammikānaṃ kammānaṃ chandaṃ datvā pacchā khīyanadhammaṃ āpajjeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
yo pana bhikkhu samaggena saṅghena cīvaraṃ datvā pacchā khīyanadhammaṃ āpajjeyya, yathāsanthutaṃ bhikkhū saṅghikaṃ lābhaṃ pariṇāmentī'ti, pācittiyaṃ.

23784.meaning1: made a complaint; criticized; whined about

examples.text: idha te, sāriputta, aññataro sabrahmacārī khīyanadhammaṃ āpanno, āyasmā maṃ, bhante, sāriputto āsajja appaṭinissajja cārikaṃ pakkanto'ti.

23785.meaning2: being exhausted, wasting away, becoming dejected

23787.meaning1: was destroyed; was exhausted; was worn away

examples.text: byādhidhammaṃ mā byādhīyīti … maraṇadhammaṃ mā mīyī'ti… khayadhammaṃ mā khīyī'ti… nassanadhammaṃ mā nassī'ti alabbhanīyaṃ ṭhānaṃ samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā devena vā mārena vā brahmunā vā kenaci vā lokasmiṃ.

23789.meaning1: to be criticized; should be complained about
23789.meaning2: should be criticized; should be complained about
23789.commentary: (DNa) khīyitabbaṃ khīyeyyā'ti pakāsetabbaṃ pakāseyya khipitabbaṃ khipeyya, hāretabbaṃ hāreyyā'ti vuttaṃ hoti. (VISMa) khīyitabban'ti khīyan'ārahaṃ nindanīyaṃ.

examples.text: evaṃ, bho'ti kho, vāseṭṭha, so satto tesaṃ sattānaṃ paṭissuṇitvā sammā khīyitabbaṃ khīyi, sammā garahitabbaṃ garahi, sammā pabbājetabbaṃ pabbājesi. te pan'assa sālīnaṃ bhāgaṃ anuppadaṃsu.

23790.meaning2: having exhausted, having wasted away, having become dejected

23791.commentary: (VIN 2.5.4.9) khīraṃ nāma gokhīraṃ vā ajikākhīraṃ vā mahiṃsakhīraṃ vā, yesaṃ maṃsaṃ kappati, tesaṃ khīraṃ.

examples.text: na hi pāpaṃ kataṃ kammaṃ, sajju khīraṃ'va muccati, ḍahantaṃ bālam'anveti, bhasmacchanno'va pāvako.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, gavā khīraṃ, khīramhā dadhi, dadhimhā navanītaṃ, navanītamhā sappi, sappimhā sappimaṇḍo tatra aggam'akkhāyati.

23792.commentary: (MNt) khīrapaṇṇino'ti khīrapaṇṇiyā, yassā chindanamatte paṇṇe khīraṃ paggharati.

examples.text: so evaṃ vadeyya, na tāv'āhaṃ imaṃ sallaṃ āharissāmi yāva na taṃ jiyaṃ jānāmi yāy'amhi viddho, yadi vā akkassa yadi vā saṇhassa yadi vā nhārussa yadi vā maruvāya yadi vā khīrapaṇṇino'ti
seyyathā'pi, bhūmija, puriso khīr'atthiko khīragavesī khīrapariyesanaṃ caramāno gāviṃ taruṇavacchaṃ visāṇato āviñcheyya.

23795.meaning1: wanting milk; in need of milk

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhūmija, puriso khīr'atthiko khīragavesī khīrapariyesanaṃ caramāno gāviṃ taruṇavacchaṃ visāṇato āviñcheyya.

23796.commentary: (SNa) khīranikā'ti khīrakārakā godohakā. na hi te ekavāram'eva thanaṃ añchanti, punappunaṃ añchantā dhenuṃ duhantī'ti attho. (SNt) khīraṃ hatthena nayantī'ti vā khīranikā.

examples.text: punappunaṃ khīranikā duhanti, punappunaṃ vaccho upeti mātaraṃ, punappunaṃ kilamati phandati ca, punappunaṃ gabbham'upeti mando.
yāva hi vanatho na chijjati, aṇumatto'pi narassa nārisu, paṭibaddhamano'va tāva so, vaccho khīrapako'va mātari.

23799.meaning2: kind of plant (whose leaves yield a milky juice)
23799.commentary: (MNa) maruvākhīrapaṇṇīnam'pi vākehiy'eva karonti. tena vuttaṃ yadi vā maruvāya yadi vā khīrapaṇṇino'ti.
23799.notes: This plant has both milky sap and fibre suitable for bowstrings.
